verdict.rationale: Ironclad's product pages and workflow APIs describe a structured contract lifecycle—no-code contract creation, Workflow Designer/launch APIs, storage, and signing—replacing ad hoc email-based contract handling with a controlled platform workflow (ironclad-docs-9, ironclad-docs-11, ironclad-docs-16, ironclad-docs-38). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of redlining/mark-up and multi-party negotiation collaboration features (track changes, version comparison) and independent hands-on evidence of the negotiation experience specifically.
